newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris July same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris July same store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Thursday its same-store sales in July rose 18 percent.
Net sales in July increased 24 percent to $11.9 million compared with $9.6 million the previous year.
Second quarter comparable store sales improved nine percent, while net sales increased 11 percent to $40.9 million.
Year-to-date comparable store sales were up 10 percent, and net sales increased 11 percent to $84.7 million.
Paul Harris is a specialty retailer of sportswear and accessories. The company currently operates 233 stores located in 27 states and the District of Columbia.
